MAPS.name: Tidewater Plaza
MAPS.blurb: A Victorian seaside square: fight round the Jubilee clock tower, under the colonnade and along the promenade.

MAPS.name: Kelpline Terminal
MAPS.blurb: A container terminal at shift change: a gantry crane straddles the pier between two moored ships. Mind the water.

MAPS.name: Halyard Marina
MAPS.blurb: Floating docks, a tug on blocks and a car ferry moored across the middle. Mind the water.

MAPS.name: Saltpan Basin
MAPS.blurb: An open salt works: sunken pans and boardwalks round a wind pump, with the shed roof and salt heap as high ground.

MAPS.name: Crossroads Market
MAPS.blurb: Narrow shop streets and an iron gallery close in on the glass Market Hall, where the No. 3 tram waits under the clock.

MAPS.name: Lockgate Canals
MAPS.blurb: Drained locks through a brick warehouse district: the canal splits the map, so hold the bridge and the gates.

MAPS.name: Terrace Heights
MAPS.blurb: A whitewashed hill village: hold the terraces, fight for the stairs and drop in on the Piazzetta.

MAPS.name: Cargo Terminal
MAPS.blurb: A container terminal at shift change: a gantry crane straddles the pier between two moored box ships.

slam.name: Tidal Slam
slam.blurb: Leap up and slam down in a huge ink shockwave.

storm.name: Ink Tempest
storm.blurb: Hurl a rain cloud that soaks the turf below.

barrage.name: Splat Bomb Barrage
barrage.blurb: Throw Splat Bombs as fast as you like for a few seconds — no ink needed. Your main weapon still works.

barrage_sticky.name: Cling Charge Barrage
barrage_sticky.blurb: Stick Cling Charges to every wall in sight — no ink needed. Your main weapon still works.

barrage_burst.name: Pop Pellet Barrage
barrage_burst.blurb: Pelt foes with rapid-fire Pop Pellets — no ink needed. Your main weapon still works.

barrage_seeker.name: Skitter Bomb Barrage
barrage_seeker.blurb: Send a pack of Skitter Bombs chasing foes, each inking a trail — no ink needed. Your main weapon still works.

barrage_mist.name: Murk Bomb Barrage
barrage_mist.blurb: Smother an area in Murk Bomb mist — no ink needed. Your main weapon still works.

bubbler.name: Bubble Guard
bubbler.blurb: A force field that turns every hit into a shove instead of damage. Touch teammates to share it.

sonar.name: Deep Sonar
sonar.blurb: Reveals every enemy to your team on screen and on the map. Revealed foes move slower and burn through ink faster.

strike.name: Vortex Strike
strike.blurb: Pick a spot on the map and launch a missile. It lands as a huge swirling vortex of ink.

zooka.name: Twister Zooka
zooka.blurb: A bazooka that fires tall twisters of ink in quick succession — splats foes at long range.

wail.name: Howl Box
wail.blurb: Hold up a huge speaker, aim it and click: it blasts a sound wave that goes through walls and splats anything in its path.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.blurb: Turn into an invincible kraken. Race through any ink (even the enemy's) and splat foes with a jump attack.

blower.name: Bubble Blower
blower.blurb: Blow up to three giant bubbles that wall off an area. Shoot them (you or your team) to set off a huge ink blast.

jetpack.name: Ink Jet
jetpack.blurb: Hover over the stage firing powerful blasts — jump for a boost. When it runs out you super jump back to where you took off (marked for everyone to see).

stamp.name: Mega Stamp
stamp.blurb: Charge forward smashing with a giant stamp: each swing deflects attacks from the front and smashes bombs before they go off, but it turns slowly and is open from the sides and back. Swing mid-air for a flip that reaches further and hits behind you too. Throw it (sub) as a long-range blast — that ends the special.

booyah.name: Cheer Orb
booyah.blurb: Hold up a ball of ink that charges over time, then throw it for a huge blast. Teammates' "Yeah!" cheers (C) charge it faster and top up their own special.

zipcaster.name: Zipline
zipcaster.blurb: Cloaked in a mysterious aura, your sub becomes a grapple: latch onto walls from afar and zip over, main weapon in hand. You super jump back when it ends (marked for everyone to see).

crab.name: Crab Rig
crab.blurb: Ride a crab tank: gatling on fire, mortar on sub, roll into an armoured ball with swim. The tank can be shot down, and you're exposed from above and behind.

bomb.name: Splat Bomb
bomb.blurb: Bounces, arms when it lands, then bursts. Splats anyone close.

sticky.name: Cling Charge
sticky.blurb: Sticks to whatever it hits (floors, walls, ceilings) and blows after a moment with a wide blast.

burst.name: Pop Pellet
burst.blurb: Pops on impact. Cheap enough to throw twice: two direct hits or three near misses splat.

seeker.name: Skitter Bomb
seeker.blurb: Scuttles after the nearest foe, laying a swimmable ink trail, and bursts when it reaches them. It turns wide: sidestep it late.

scan.name: Echo Orb
scan.blurb: Bursts into a sensing cloud. Foes it touches are tracked for your whole team. No damage.

curtain.name: Drip Curtain
curtain.blurb: Drops a wall of falling ink that stops enemy players and shots. It fades over time, faster when shot.

sprinkler.name: Twirl Sprinkler
sprinkler.blurb: Sticks to any surface and sprays ink around it in pulses, until it is shot or you get splatted.

mine.name: Lurk Mine
mine.blurb: Planted at your feet and hidden in your ink. Foes who come close are hit and tracked. Two at a time.

beacon.name: Hop Beacon
beacon.blurb: A super-jump point for your team. Place up to three; each takes two jumps.

mist.name: Murk Bomb
mist.blurb: Releases a poison mist that slows foes and drains their ink. A direct hit keeps them poisoned until the mist fades.

shaker.name: Shaker Bomb
shaker.blurb: Hold to shake it up (mash jump, keep moving): up to three blasts that hop it forward.

waddle.name: Waddle Bomb
waddle.blurb: Waddles after foes it senses near where it lands, noisily. Blows up where it lands if nobody is near.

torpedo.name: Tide Torpedo
torpedo.blurb: Locks onto a foe in mid-air, then darts at them and bursts into droplets. One out at a time.

tracer.name: Tracer Bolt
tracer.blurb: A fast bolt fired a little low that skims and ricochets, puddling ink on every bounce. Hits and its trail mark foes for your team.

boomerang.name: Whirl Boomerang
boomerang.blurb: Spins out, hovers and shreds, whirls back round you, then bursts. Hit a foe and it bursts on them like a Splat Bomb. One out at a time.

bomb.name: Splat Bomb
bomb.blurb: Bounces, arms when it lands, then bursts. Splats anyone close.

sticky.name: Cling Charge
sticky.blurb: Sticks to whatever it hits (floors, walls, ceilings) and blows after a moment with a wide blast.

beacon.blurb: A super-jump point for your team. Place up to three; each takes two jumps.

mist.blurb: Releases a poison mist that slows foes and drains their ink. A direct hit keeps them poisoned until the mist fades.

shaker.name: Shaker Bomb
shaker.blurb: Hold to shake it up (mash jump, keep moving): up to three blasts that hop it forward.

waddle.name: Waddle Bomb
waddle.blurb: Waddles after foes it senses near where it lands, noisily. Blows up where it lands if nobody is near.

boomerang.name: Whirl Boomerang
boomerang.blurb: Spins out, hovers and shreds, whirls back round you, then bursts. Hit a foe and it bursts on them like a Splat Bomb. One out at a time.

shooter.name: Spritzer
shooter.blurb: Rapid-fire all-rounder. Sprays a steady stream of ink blobs.

roller.name: Swell Roller
roller.blurb: Roll out wide stripes of turf. Flick for a crushing splash.

charger.name: Glint Charger
charger.blurb: Hold to charge, release for a long piercing line. Full charge splats.

blaster.name: Popper Blaster
blaster.blurb: Slow shots that burst mid-air. Direct hits splat instantly.

bucket.name: Bilge Bucket
bucket.blurb: Hurl a wave of ink in an arc: aim higher to throw farther, lob it over cover. Full damage at any distance; two hits splat.

spinner.name: Squall Spinner
spinner.blurb: Spin up, then unleash a stream of ink. A full spin reaches farthest and fires longest.

twins.name: Twinfire Pistols
twins.blurb: Paired pistols. Jump while firing to dodge-roll; stand still after a roll for rapid, longer-range fire. Walking returns to dual mode.

brush.name: Swish Brush
brush.blurb: Dash along the ground leaving a thin trail, or swipe side to side to flick a spray of small globs.

brolly.name: Canopy Brolly
brolly.blurb: A shotgun spray of ink pellets. Hold to open the canopy: a shield for you and your team. Keep holding to launch it as a rolling wall.

bow.name: Tideline Bow
bow.blurb: Draw to fill two rings, then loose three arrows at once: a flat fan on the ground, an upright one in the air. Past the first ring the arrows stick where they land and burst.

blade.name: Brine Cutlass
blade.blurb: Tap for quick slashes that fling a crescent of ink. Hold to charge an overhead cut that sends a long ink wave. The blade itself hits hard: a charged cut splats in one hit.

mitts.name: Sponge Mitts
mitts.blurb: Punch out ink fists that burst a few metres ahead — with your gloves up, the sponge soaks part of any hit from the front. Hold fire and press jump to charge a long leap that splashes where you land, and sticks you to walls (holding on drains ink).

dualies.name: Twinfin Dualies
dualies.blurb: Twin pistols, alternating fire. Jump while firing to dodge-roll, then plant and unload.

slosher.name: Tidebucket Slosher
slosher.blurb: Heaves a heavy wave of ink in an arc: over cover, up ledges, a thick stripe where it lands.

splatling.name: Gyre Splatling
splatling.blurb: Hold to spin up, release for a long high-speed stream. The more charge, the longer it lasts.

PRESETS.name: Rookie
PRESETS.blurb: Fresh off the ferry, ringer tee and long tentacles.

PRESETS.name: Dash
PRESETS.blurb: Track-top sprinter with a spiky quiff.

PRESETS.name: Pip
PRESETS.blurb: Twin tails, breton stripes, always first to the ferry deck.

PRESETS.name: Marlo
PRESETS.blurb: Ponytail up, jersey on, game face.

PRESETS.name: Riptide
PRESETS.blurb: Mohawk crest and a splatter tee. Loud.

PRESETS.name: Nori
PRESETS.blurb: Low bun under a bucket hat, splat camo, very patient charger main.

PRESETS.name: Suki
PRESETS.blurb: Side-swept and too cool for the lobby.

ZH_PHRASES.NAME: 名字
ZH_PHRASES.A Victorian seaside square: fight round: 维多利亚风的海滨广场：围着 jubilee 钟楼交战，穿过柱廊，沿滨海步道推进。
ZH_PHRASES.A container terminal at shift change: a: 换班时的集装箱码头：一座龙门吊横跨在两艘停泊船只之间的栈桥上。小心落水。
ZH_PHRASES.Floating docks, a tug on blocks and a ca: 漂浮的浮码头、搁在垫块上的拖船，还有一艘横停在中央的车客渡轮。小心落水。
ZH_PHRASES.An open salt works: sunken pans and boar: 开阔的盐场：沉洼的盐池与环绕风车的木栈道，工棚屋顶和盐堆是制高点。
ZH_PHRASES.Narrow shop streets and an iron gallery: 狭窄的店铺街巷与铁艺骑楼围向玻璃市场大厅——3 号电车正候在钟下。
ZH_PHRASES.Drained locks through a brick warehouse: 穿行砖砌仓库区的干涸船闸：运河把地图一分为二，守住桥与闸门。
ZH_PHRASES.A whitewashed hill village: hold the ter: 刷白的山村：守住层层梯台，争夺阶梯，再空降突入小广场。
ZH_PHRASES.A container terminal at shift change: a: 换班时的集装箱码头：一座龙门吊横跨在两艘停泊货箱船之间的栈桥上。
ZH_PHRASES.Relaxed bots with shaky aim. Great for l: 轻松的机器人，枪法发颤。适合新手入门。
ZH_PHRASES.Balanced bots that push turf and fight b: 均衡的机器人：推进涂地、正面迎击。
ZH_PHRASES.Sharp, aggressive bots that punish mista: 精准凶狠的机器人，会惩罚你的失误。拿出真本事来。
ZH_PHRASES.A sleepier crab: less HP, softer hits an: 打瞌睡的螃蟹：血量更低、攻击更轻，出招间隔也更长。
ZH_PHRASES.The full HULLBREAKER. Dodge the tells, p: 完整实力的 HULLBREAKER。躲开前摇，抓住破绽。
ZH_PHRASES.Tougher shell, harder hits, relentless p: 更硬的壳、更狠的攻击、毫无停歇的节奏。带上整个小队来吧。
ZH_PHRASES.Rapid-fire all-rounder. Sprays a steady: 全能速射武器，喷洒连绵不断的墨水弹。
ZH_PHRASES.Roll out wide stripes of turf. Flick for: 滚出宽阔的涂地条带。甩击可泼出致命墨花。
ZH_PHRASES.Hold to charge, release for a long pierc: 按住蓄力，松开放出贯穿的长线。满蓄力一击致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Slow shots that burst mid-air. Direct hi: 缓慢的炮弹在空中爆开。直接命中一击致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Hurl a wave of ink in an arc: aim higher: 挥出一道抛物线墨浪：瞄得越高扔得越远，可以越过掩体。任何距离伤害不减；两击致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Spin up, then unleash a stream of ink. A: 先转管预热，再倾泻墨流。完全预热后射程最远、火力最久。
ZH_PHRASES.Paired pistols. Jump while firing to dod: 成对手枪。开火时跳跃可翻滚闪避；翻滚后站定进入速射长程模式。移动则回到双手模式。
ZH_PHRASES.Dash along the ground leaving a thin tra: 贴地冲刺留下细细墨痕，或左右挥甩泼出小墨滴。
ZH_PHRASES.A shotgun spray of ink pellets. Hold to: 霰弹般的墨水喷射。按住张开伞面：为你和队友提供护盾。继续按住可将其掷出，变成滚动的屏障。
ZH_PHRASES.Draw to fill two rings, then loose three: 拉弓填满两道环，一次射出三支箭：平射在地上排开，空中则为竖排。超过第一道环后箭会钉在落点并爆开。
ZH_PHRASES.Tap for quick slashes that fling a cresc: 轻按快速挥砍，甩出新月墨花。按住蓄力劈砍，放出长长的墨浪。刀刃本身伤害极高：蓄力斩一击致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Punch out ink fists that burst a few met: 挥拳打出墨水拳套，在数米外爆开——举起拳套时，海绵能吸收正面伤害的一部分。按住开火再按跳跃可蓄力远跳，落地泼墨并可扒墙（扒墙持续耗墨）。
ZH_PHRASES.Bounces, arms when it lands, then bursts: 落地后待机引爆，随即爆开。近处的人直接致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Sticks to whatever it hits (floors, wall: 粘在命中的任何表面（地面、墙面、天花板），片刻后大范围引爆。
ZH_PHRASES.Pops on impact. Cheap enough to throw tw: 接触即炸。耗墨低到可以连扔两颗：两次直接命中或三次近失即可致命。
ZH_PHRASES.Scuttles after the nearest foe, laying a: 追着最近的敌人爬行，留下可潜泳的墨迹，追上即爆。它转弯半径大：晚一点侧闪即可躲开。
ZH_PHRASES.Bursts into a sensing cloud. Foes it tou: 爆开成感知云。接触到的敌人会被全队标记。不造成伤害。
ZH_PHRASES.Drops a wall of falling ink that stops e: 落下一道垂落的墨帘，阻挡敌方玩家和子弹。随时间消退，被射击时消退更快。
ZH_PHRASES.Sticks to any surface and sprays ink aro: 粘在任何表面上，脉冲式向四周喷墨，直到被击毁或你被击倒。
ZH_PHRASES.Planted at your feet and hidden in your: 种在脚下，藏进你的墨水里。靠近的敌人会被炸伤并标记。最多同时两个。
ZH_PHRASES.A super-jump point for your team. Place: 给全队用的超级跳跃点。最多放三个；每个可用两次。
ZH_PHRASES.Releases a poison mist that slows foes a: 释放毒雾，减速敌人并抽干其墨水。直接命中会让中毒持续到毒雾消散。
ZH_PHRASES.Hold to shake it up (mash jump, keep mov: 按住摇晃（连按跳跃、保持移动）：最多三段爆炸，边炸边向前跳。
